what: The shared refusal vocabulary. Every refusal a conforming lint emits MUST appear here, and every code here MUST have a rule in src/rules.mjs. SPEC section 7's table is GENERATED from this file; a code the vocabulary does not name is itself a refusal (E_CODE_UNKNOWN). This is the one source: the spec table, the registry, and the battery all read it, so the three can never drift.

severity.warning: acknowledged; reported, never refuses on its own

codes.detail: a directory holds records but no family declares it
a family key disagrees with the directory it is declared for
a family declares a schema and a record in it carries a different one
a record's declared id disagrees with its filename stem
a field ends _id/_ids and no edge declares it, and it is not literal
a declared edge names a target no record in the target family carries
a declared scalar ref chain returns to its start
two edges declare the same (family, field)
a profile or baseline names a refusal code the vocabulary does not carry
a baseline's expiry has passed; the acknowledged refusal is no longer excused
a baseline excuses a refusal that no longer occurs; reported so it can be retired
the root passed is not the tree root: its children are records (a family directory), or one family spans many directories and schemas (a directory above the tree root), so no edge can resolve
the root holds no .tres records, so a clean verdict would be vacuous
